morphology.pattern_note: 输入包把 berdebar 当成词根，应纠正为 debar。ber- 接在 d 前保持原形，不发生鼻音替换；两个 e 均读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 使人心跳加快；扣人心弦

senses.zh_definition: 心脏较快或明显地跳动；常因紧张、惊吓、恐惧或期待而怦怦直跳。
senses.en_definition: For the heart to beat rapidly or noticeably, especially through nervousness, fear, surprise, or anticipation.
senses.ms_definition: Jantung atau nadi berdenyut dengan agak pantas, misalnya ketika seseorang berasa cemas, takut atau terkejut.
senses.nuances: 属于不及物动词。jantung berdebar 强调生理感受，hati berdebar 常表达紧张或期待；Saya berdebar 也自然。词语本身不等同于医学诊断。释义与词根据 [DBP：debar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=debar)，马来文为转述。

collocations.en: to wait for the results with one's heart racing

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Calon itu mengakui bahawa jantungnya berdebar sebelum sesi temu duga bermula.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那名应聘者坦言，面试开始前自己的心跳得很快。
dual_scenarios.en: The candidate admitted that his heart was racing before the interview began.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah berdebar ni, kejap lagi nak masuk bilik temu duga.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah berasa berdebar kerana sebentar lagi saya akan masuk ke bilik temu duga.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经紧张得心怦怦跳了，马上就要进面试室。
dual_scenarios.en: My heart's already racing. I'm about to go into the interview room.
spoken_features: kejap 对应 sekejap 或 sebentar
nak 在此表示即将进行的动作

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah berdebar ni. Kejap lagi nak masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah berasa berdebar. Sebentar lagi saya akan masuk.
messages.zh: 我已经紧张得心怦怦跳了，马上就要进去了。
messages.en: My heart's racing. I'm going in any minute.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tarik nafas dulu. Kau dah buat persediaan, jawab satu-satu je.
messages.ms_standard: Tarik nafas dahulu. Kamu sudah membuat persediaan; jawab soalan satu demi satu sahaja.
messages.zh: 先深呼吸。你都准备好了，一题一题答就行。
messages.en: Take a breath. You've prepared for this—just take one question at a time.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places berdebar under debar, the beat of the heart or pulse. With ber-, that beat becomes an ongoing bodily experience. Malay readily connects the sensation with emotion: jantung highlights the physical heart, while hati can frame the same pounding as fear, suspense, or eager anticipation. The repeated form berdebar-debar makes the sensation especially vivid.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 de-bar 想成心跳的两拍“怦—怦”；ber-debar 就是心正在怦怦跳。这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya berdebar 适合向同事或面试官坦诚表达紧张；aku berdebar 更适合朋友。用它安慰别人时，应承认对方的感受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于面试、考试、比赛、惊喜或约会前的心情。hati berdebar 不必然表示恋爱，也可能只是担心或期待。
